description: Add a geographic target (or exclusion) to a campaign, using PRESENCE-only targeting by default (people IN the location, not merely interested) — this is the India-fraud-safe setting. Pass negative:true to exclude a geo. Common geo IDs: 2840=US, 2826=UK, 2124=CA, 2036=AU, 2276=DE, 2356=India. Refs #5742.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

negative.description: true = exclude this geo. Default false (positive target).

name: gads_add_geo_target
